name: Build to Surround the Zombie💥
desc:
Many maps to choose!

🔥We 🛠build defense walls🧱 and devices🗲⚡︎...

🔥We pick up 🔫guns...

🔥We need 🚁save more humanity!

After killing the ☣︎Titan Zombie BOSS☣︎, we'll take the helicopter to the next area, and the whole world is waiting for us to save.

Can humans escape smoothly?

-----CONTROLS-----

[ Mobile ]
Select Building - Tap Build Icon
Confirm Build - Tap Build Icon
Switch Build/Shoot - Tap UI Button
Grenade - Tap UI Button

[ PC ]
Select Building -  Press 1~4 Key
Confirm Build -  Press 1~4 Key / Mouse Left
Switch Build/Shoot - Press F
Grenade -  Press C

...

MUTI BATTLE!
